items.title: How thin does a fixed 1:1 budget spread as a team grows?
items.description: Priya's weekly 1:1 budget is fixed at 180 minutes (3 hours), no matter how many people report to her. Drag the team size to see why 1:1 time isn't a soft management-style choice — it's simple division against a fixed pool, and it's what actually turned 36 minutes into 16 as her team grew from 5 to 11.
items.compute: const weeklyBudgetMinutes = 180; const minutesPerReport = Math.round((weeklyBudgetMinutes / params.teamSize) * 10) / 10; return { minutesPerReport };

items.title: Why one team of 20 costs more coordination than two pods of 10
items.description: The number of communication links inside a team grows combinatorially with headcount (n(n-1)/2 pairs), not linearly. At month 18, Priya's org is 20 engineers total. Drag team size to see why keeping all 20 as one team costs far more coordination than splitting into two pods of roughly 10 each.
